caption:
Lulu slipped at the gym and his shoulder popped out. Once a doctor confirmed it was back in place, the big question was how to get back to work and training.

Recovery after a dislocation usually moves in stages: protect, strengthen, return. The shoulder's response sets the pace, not the calendar. Early on, keep the elbow and wrist moving, then build rotator cuff and shoulder blade strength, then test strength and confidence in the positions your job or sport needs.

Numbness, a shoulder that feels unstable again, or pain that keeps building are worth a prompt review. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can guide each stage. Book online via the link in bio 💪
